sourceReasoning.finding: ConditionEvaluator.EvaluateCondition explicitly calls the collecting overload with conditionedPropertiesTable:null at lines 193-203. MultipleComparisonNode.UpdateConditionedProperties is gated by a nonnull table at lines 115-139. Therefore omitting this excluded inventory is an existing source evaluation mode, not an invented Boolean algorithm.

Both emptiness checks occur first (63-64). If either is empty, the result after inventory update is Compare(leftEmpty,rightEmpty) (65-69). A StringExpressionNode containing empty text or the undefined property is empty; operator nodes use GenericExpressionNode.EvaluatesToEmpty=false. EqualExpressionNode compares these Boolean flags with ==. Thus each exact fault case produces false in the no-inventory mode.

For the actual collecting path, the scalar has a nonnull unexpanded representation while the opposite function/comparison operator has null expanded text. UpdateConditionedProperties passes that null to UpdateConditionedPropertiesTable; line 39 accesses rightValueExpanded.Length before checking whether the scalar names a property. This also explains EMPTY-08 despite its left scalar being literal empty text. Grouping returns its child node directly. The actual frozen stacks identify this same call chain.

The empty result must be determined without BoolEvaluate of HasTrailingSlash or the nested comparison. Do not flatten operator values to true/false strings, pre-evaluate all operands, translate every NullReferenceException to false, or special-case fixture IDs. Preserve the generic empty/numeric/Boolean/string decision order.

sourceObligations: Try invariant decimal Double conversion with AllowDecimalPoint|AllowLeadingSign, reject infinite results, then try prefixed Int32 hexadecimal. Do not admit Java exponent/suffix/hex-float/whitespace syntax through an unrestricted parseDouble call.
Retain signed 32-bit hexadecimal semantics, including 0x80000000=-2147483648 and 0xffffffff=-1. Leading zero width alone is not rejection: 0x000000001 compares equal to 1.
Attempt numeric comparison only if both conversions succeed, then Boolean only if both succeed, then valid expanded string representations. Keep left-to-right short circuit of conversion calls.
Numeric equality and inequality use primitive double == and !=, including NaN != NaN and signed zero equality; do not use object equality or Double.compare semantics.
Reject overflow-to-infinity as a numeric conversion so identical overflow text can match through string fallback. Infinity spellings are string fallback rather than accepted infinite numbers.

Keep numeric token lexing separate from numeric conversion. Bare 1e2==100 is the recorded MSB4092 error; quoted '1e2' versus '100' succeeds with false. Numeric text survives failed conversion; no Version equality coercion.
Respect binary64 rounding at the exact half-ULP and its successor, 9007199254740993 versus 9007199254740992, and the observed 2e-324/4e-324/5e-324 full-decimal boundaries.
Quoted and expanded scalars take the same ordinary numeric conversion path; preserve one-pass expansion/unescape and the declared reserved-property exclusion.
selectedFindings: BOOL-NUM-25 in both orders equals 1 at the exact half-ULP; BOOL-NUM-26 in both orders is unequal.

risksAndLimitations: Disabling inventory changes the selected native Project-load outcome for these three cases. This is a deliberate documented private adaptation even though the source contains a no-collection evaluation mode.

The three observed faults do not prove that no other input can reach the same null inventory path. Implement the source no-inventory semantics generally; retain separate dispositions for any future observed differences.
The empty optimization applies to == and != through Boolean emptiness comparison; unequal emptiness makes != true. Do not generalize this review into a rule that every empty comparison is false.
Empty scalar alone is non-Boolean; empty Condition attribute remains true. The three false outcomes do not redefine either rule.
Skipped P/Q are fixture expectations under their initial state, not an instruction to clear existing properties when a condition is false.
All native/helper files are frozen. This report is source review, not independent runtime replication, implementation review, artifact qualification or acceptance.
